title: SDS 755: Brewing Beer with A.I., with Beau Warren
summary: Species X head brewer Beau Warren explains how he cleaned 180 features across 300-plus beers and used AutoML tools to generate a machine-learning-designed lager.

title: Ep 24: Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Brewing
summary: Brewer and senior data analyst Ankur Napa walks through machine learning, fermentation monitoring, and predictive analytics for brewhouse efficiency.

title: Episode 063: Utilizing Predictive Analytics to Improve Quality and Maximize Capacity at Deschutes Brewery
summary: Deschutes brewmaster Brian Faivre describes how one of the largest craft brewers uses data and predictive analytics tools to improve process and capacity.

title: Episode 309: Predicting and improving complex beer flavor through machine learning
summary: Kevin Verstrepen and Michiel Schreurs discuss their Nature Communications research using chemical analytics and machine learning to predict and improve beer flavor.

title: Episode 253: [LIVE] Artificial Intelligence and Brewing
summary: Hosts Denny Luce and Kris McKenzie discuss AI in brewing and consumer engagement, referencing the Deep Liquid beer AI project.

title: Better Data Science and AI Technologies for Better Vine and Wine?
summary: Scout CEO Kia Behnia and Tastry founder Katerina Axelsson cover AI for precision viticulture and consumer preference prediction across the wine chain.

title: Ep 71: Data Science and AI in the wine industry with Aubrey Terrazas
summary: Sommelier and data science MS candidate Aubrey Terrazas explains using data science to match customers to wines from vineyard to glass.

title: Mapping Flavor Profiles for Wine w/ Katerina Axelsson, Tastry
summary: Tastry CEO Katerina Axelsson details an AI and analytical-chemistry system that maps wine flavor profiles to consumer taste data for winemaking decisions.

title: Getting more sales analytics manpower with AI w/ Jeremy Hart, Somm.ai
summary: Somm.ai co-founder Jeremy Hart explains AI-driven sales analytics across roughly 100,000 on-premise wine accounts for benchmarking and pricing.

title: The distillery with an AI-backed plan to lift their spirits
summary: Bespoken Spirits uses machine learning to finish whiskey in days rather than years and applies AI to marketing for a small team.
